name: Spiders' Hunting Pit
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters
description: Loose debris covers a patch of what appears as solid ground in a 10 feet by 5 feet area. It's actually covering thin webbing strung over a 20 foot pit.
disable: DC 18 Thievery (trained) to deconstruct the webbing or DC 20 Acrobatics to pull the webbing apart without getting trapped or hit by rocks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pitfall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature that isn't a spider walks onto the webbing

Effect The triggering creature falls in, taking (2d10+13) Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save from rocks tumbling into the pit.
